تنتهزوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَهِزُوا (tantahizū) /tan.ta.hi.zuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
# تُنْتَهَزُوا (tuntahazū) /tun.ta.ha.zuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
